Rebecca Munce

Preserved Primary Document • munce-r3.htm

Rebecca Munce was born in Kent Co., DE on 28 January, 1874. She was the daughter of Isaiah Zaddock Munce and Elmira Carty Like two of her sisters, Lydia and Margaret, Rebecca married one of the sons of Benjamin and Sally Ann Durham. Rebecca married Clement Durham. Rebecca and Clement moved to Cumberland Co., NJ and had the following children: Clement Durham, married Viola Jackson Anna Durham, married Wilbert Cuff Rebecca died in 1930? (possibly 1945) in Fairfield Township, Cumberland Co., NJ. Clement died in 1947.
